messages:
Maya R: spotted odd numbers on the latency pane: /v1/completions p50=340ms but p95=190ms. looks inverted on na-prod quick summary.
Jorge: that usually points to rollup merge artifacts or mixed sample origins. quick summary or endpoint breakdown?
Maya R: quick summary tile under Endpoints -> /v1/completions. small screenshot: https://img.redwood/snap/zzz
Liam: did we change any routing tags or provenance flags in last deploy? I vaguely remember a fallback provenance tweak.
deploy-bot: deploy 6135895000 finished: feature toggle routing.provenance=include_fallback true by @ci-bot
Anya: p95 < p50 often happens when the UI shows merged tdigest rollups that combined origins with different counts and our merge weight code didn't normalize tiny-origin contributions properly.
Jorge: concrete repro: kvcache origin returns many sub-100ms samples but low counts; client origin has fewer slower samples. tdigest merge underweights the slow tail so the p95 ends up lower than the p50.
Maya R: wants: 1) show sample_count on the summary tile 2) surface an origins legend when multiple origins exist 3) an inline "low-sample" indicator for micro-slices
Liam: backend changes: include sample_count and origins list in rollup API; fix tdigest merge normalization to protect against tiny-origin bias; add provenance query param so console can request full origins when user toggles.
Anya: UX suggestion: an inline toggle next to percentiles: 'Show sample provenance'. when enabled, console will call rollup?provenance=origins and show origin breakdown. keep default off to avoid extra API overhead.
Maya R: also request a lightweight tooltip: 'Percentiles computed from merged rollups. Enable provenance to see per-origin percentiles.' plus an orange badge when sample_count < 75 (configurable).
Jorge: implementation ETA: patch merge algorithm + rollup response fields in ~48 hours. will add a migration job to recompute suspect rollups once fix lands.
Liam: opening PR to expose provenance param and sample_count in the API; will add unit tests for tdigest weight normalization and some integration smoke tests.
Anya: console plan: add inline toggle and hovercard showing sample_count and origin breakdown. PM approved subtle inline change.
Liam: PR #1301 opened: rollup: add provenance param, include sample_count & origins array. added weight-normalization unit tests.
Jorge: tests green locally; pushing to staging.
deploy-bot: deploy 6135900300 to staging by @ci-bot :white_check_mark:
Maya R: checked staging for the problematic window: p95 now 380ms > p50 340ms. low-sample badge visible for micro-slice. looks fixed.
Liam: scheduling prod deploy tonight 23:45 UTC (6135931500). will post when live.
deploy-bot: scheduled 6135931500 for prod deploy by @release-scheduler
Maya R: please add a short note to the runbook explaining the low-sample badge meaning and how to enable provenance for support ops.
Anya: adding runbook snippet now.
Maya R: thanks everyone. happy it's telemetry/merge logic and not an actual regression in serving.
